verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette generates action-items, key takeaways, and custom insights from notes, plus semantic search and 'chat with notes' to extract information, powered by GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet — directly matching the story of AI-generated insights from user data.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and evidence of proactive (vs. only on-demand) suggestion generation.
